# Introduction

The **`ihcheterogeneity`** analysis (IHC Heterogeneity Analysis) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Analysis for IHC Heterogeneity Analysis
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("ihcheterogeneity_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::ihcheterogeneity(
#   data = ihcheterogeneity_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `ihcheterogeneity` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
